MAKE IT SOUND LIKE YOU

Your adventure. Your soundtrack.

Record a silly voice, sing a tune, or upload an audio file. Choose where each sound plays in your game.

Opening your sound library…

1. Make a sound

Recording asks for microphone access. Record up to 2 minutes; uploads can be up to 20 MB. The launcher saves sounds into the game folder. Without the launcher, sounds stay in this browser. For microphone access, use localhost or HTTPS.

Play a piano or xylophone

Tap the keys or use A W S E D F T G Y H U J K on your keyboard. Record a tune to turn it into game music or a sound effect. No microphone needed!

Tunes save as WAV audio in your library. A tune can be up to one minute or 256 notes. Switch instruments during a tune to mix both sounds.

2. Your sound library

3. Choose your game sounds

Choices save automatically. Music loops during play. Choose “Silent” to turn any sound off.
